title: Qui veult aymer il fault estre joyeulx (Willaert)
desc: Adrian Willaert, Qui veult aymer il fault estre joyeulx. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
